description: This file defines data models and associated logic for tracking usage data, including gateway usage windows, providers, summaries, and UI presentation logic in a Swift application.

classes.name: GatewayUsageWindow
classes.description: Represents a usage window for a gateway, including label, used percentage, and optional reset time.

classes.name: GatewayUsageProvider
classes.description: Contains details about a usage provider, including display name, plan, windows, and error information.

classes.name: GatewayUsageSummary
classes.description: Aggregates provider usage data and provides methods to extract primary usage rows.

classes.name: UsageRow
classes.description: Represents a row of usage data for display purposes, including computed properties for UI logic.

methods.name: primaryRows
methods.description: Generates a list of primary usage rows based on the provider data, selecting the window with maximum used percent.

methods.name: detailText
methods.description: Returns a detailed string description of remaining usage, window label, and reset time.

methods.name: formatResetRemaining
methods.description: Formats the reset time remaining as a string, handling various time ranges.

methods.name: loadSummary
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and decodes the usage summary data from a remote control channel.
